subject: Re: Atlas co-sell telemetry & evidence packaging — marketplace readiness
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@atlas-integrations.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Atlas marketplace evidence ask and SKU matrix

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Atlas is excited about the co-sell potential. Our marketplace intake team asked for a consolidated "evidence pack" that proves telemetry, billing, and entitlement behavior across AWS/Azure/GCP. Specifically they want:

- Example telemetry payloads (metrics + traces) we can map into our sell-with dashboards
- A sample billing reconciliation (how your token/ingest metrics map to marketplace SKUs)
- STIG-level architecture diagram we can attach to the listing
- A small runbook showing how to reproduce a canary traffic test (so our QA can validate telemetry signals)

I've attached the atlas_sku_matrix.xlsx with the SKU names we plan to list (first tab) — those will also dictate entitlement mapping for co-sell. Can Redwood put together a minimal evidence bundle for certification? We need a first cut by Sep 25 if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah Lewis
Director, Partnerships — Atlas Integrations

Attachment: atlas_sku_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 23KB)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@atlas-integrations.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas marketplace evidence ask and SKU matrix

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask and the SKU matrix. We can own the evidence bundle, here's what we'll deliver and the owners: 

- Architecture diagram (Redwood infra + integration points) — owner: me (Grace)
- Telemetry sample payloads (Prometheus + OTLP traces) + mapping notes — owner: Mateo
- Billing reconciliation example (sample invoice + SKU mapping) — owner: Ben
- Canary test runbook + simple scripts to generate traffic — owner: Mateo
- Compliance note (what we can include vs what requires your SOC2 artifacts) — owner: Olga

I've attached our Redwood_evidence_checklist_v1.pdf so you can see the format we usually submit. Quick Qs: 1) do you want region-specific telemetry (us/eu/apac) in the first cut, or is US-only fine for the initial cert? 2) Are the SKU names in atlas_sku_matrix final, or will they change during the procurement process?

Proposed timeline: first draft evidence bundle by Sep 24, internal review Sep 25, handoff to Atlas cert team Sep 26. Can we set a 30 minute intake call tomorrow to lock scope?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partner GTM (Redwood Inference)

Attachment: redwood_evidence_checklist_v1.pdf (doc, 48KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, sarah.lewis@atlas-integrations.com
Date: 2026-09-18T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas marketplace evidence ask and SKU matrix

Couple of tactical notes from the billing/operations side: 

- We can generate a sample reconciliation using a one-week test run that maps token consumption to the SKU matrix. I'll produce a CSV with line items and a mock invoice.
- For telemetry, we should include both Prometheus metrics and an OTLP envelope. That gives Atlas enough to wire into their sell-with dashboards.
- Mateo — will you be able to produce the telemetry-sample.json and a short packaging-guidance.md for them to consume?

Also looping in Olga for any red flags on evidence that will trigger legal/terms review (metering language, resale clauses).

Ben
VP, Alliances (Redwood Inference)
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, sarah.lewis@atlas-integrations.com
Date: 2026-09-20T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas marketplace evidence ask and SKU matrix

Thanks — I'll own the telemetry artifacts and the canary runbook. Plan below: 

1) Telemetry-sample.json — contains a representative OTLP trace and Prometheus scrape snippet showing request_count, latency_p95, kv_cache_hit_ratio, and token_consumed_counter. (will attach)
2) Packaging-guidance.md — step-by-step for Atlas intake team on where to place artifacts in their cert portal and how to validate signals.
3) Canary schedule — propose a 2-hour window on Sep 24 where we generate traffic from a dedicated test instance in us-west-2; results exported to the sample telemetry output and a reconciliation CSV.

Open questions for Atlas (Sarah): please confirm the following before we finalize: 
- Final SKU names (as in your matrix) that we should map to token tiers
- Whether Atlas wants per-region sample manifests or a single global example

I'll attach the first telemetry sample and the packaging guidance for your review.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Principal Engineer, Partner Integrations (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: telemetry-sample.json (snippet, 6KB), packaging-guidance.md (text, 4KB)
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@atlas-integrations.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@atlas-integrations.com, devops@atlas-integrations.com
Date: 2026-09-21T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas marketplace evidence ask and SKU matrix

Team —

This looks great and aligned with what our certification team needs. Quick confirmations: 

- SKU names in atlas_sku_matrix.xlsx are final for this launch; we'll flag any procurement name changes early but treat these as canonical for the evidence bundle.
- US-only samples are fine for the first submission; we'll request regionized artifacts for EU later in Q4.
- We'll schedule the canary window on Sep 24 (Atlas QA has availability 10:00–12:00 PT).

I'll also share a brief security intake we use for co-sell listings — attaching atlas_security_intake.pdf. Olga, once you review that, let us know if Redwood needs to include additional compliance notes.

Next steps: 1) Redwood sends the first evidence bundle by Sep 24 EOD 2) Atlas runs cert canary Sep 24 (10:00–12:00 PT) 3) Follow-up review Sep 25 to triage any gaps.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Cheers,
Sarah
Director, Partnerships — Atlas Integrations

Attachment: atlas_security_intake.pdf (doc, 32KB)
